narrative: The June 25 in-the-wild Langflow IDOR and the AutoGPT SSRF bypass keep the agentic attack-surface drumbeat loud, the buyer-side pressure feeding demand for measurable security bars. OWASP Global AppSec USA (Nov 5-6, SF) sits in the window. But these are authorization and request-forgery flaws, not prompt-injection ones, so contact with the numeric-resistance bar is oblique.
remaining_gap: No procurement document specifying a numeric prompt-injection-resistance threshold; today gives thematic pressure and a standards venue, not the bar itself.
